Destined Rivals Elite Trainer Box.blurb: Nine Destined Rivals booster packs, a full-art foil promo and everything you need to sleeve up and start playing, all in one box. It's factory sealed and ships from our shop with the same care we give every card, so it's ready to rip open at your kitchen table. Perfect for the collector who loves the thrill of the pull, or anyone starting their first collection.
contents: 9 Scarlet & Violet: Destined Rivals booster packs
1 full-art foil promo card featuring Team Rocket's Wobbuffet
1 Player's Guide to the Destined Rivals expansion
1 code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live
